accepted: The council closed the public pool for the summer. According to the council, the pool needs repairs, whereas residents claim that closing it in summer is a mistake. The council closed the public pool for the summer. The council says that it needs repairs, while residents argue that closing it in summer is a mistake. As a result, children have no place to swim. es: Presentar una valoración de la cobertura de una noticia con evidencia, conceder un punto al interlocutor y matizar una crítica.

teaching.en: I would say the coverage was fairly balanced.
teaching.es: Yo diría que la cobertura fue bastante equilibrada.
teaching.explanationEs: I would say suaviza tu opinión; fairly modera el adjetivo.
segments: I would say the
coverage was fairly balanced.
teaching.audioText: I would say the coverage was fairly balanced.

teaching.en: It was rather one-sided, because it used only one source.
teaching.es: Fue más bien unilateral, porque usó solo una fuente.
teaching.explanationEs: Rather = más bien: matiza sin exagerar. Después de because va la evidencia.
segments: It was rather one-sided, because
it used only one source.
teaching.audioText: It was rather one-sided, because it used only one source.

teaching.en: You have a point: that criticism is valid.
teaching.es: Tienes razón: esa crítica es válida.
teaching.explanationEs: You have a point concede un argumento. No se dice «you have reason».
segments: You have a point:
that criticism is valid.
teaching.audioText: You have a point: that criticism is valid.

teaching.en: That said, to some extent the report was biased: the headline was loaded.
teaching.es: Dicho esto, hasta cierto punto el reportaje fue parcial: el titular estaba cargado.
teaching.explanationEs: That said vuelve al argumento contrario; to some extent modera la crítica.
segments: That said, to some extent the report
was biased: the headline was loaded.
teaching.audioText: That said, to some extent the report was biased: the headline was loaded.

teaching.en: On balance, the coverage was fair, because it gave both sides.
teaching.es: En conjunto, la cobertura fue justa, porque dio los dos lados.
teaching.explanationEs: On balance abre la conclusión final, tras pesar los argumentos.
segments: On balance, the coverage was fair,
because it gave both sides.
teaching.audioText: On balance, the coverage was fair, because it gave both sides.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo matizas «The coverage was biased» para no sonar tan tajante?

choices.text: The coverage was biased, end of story.
I would say the coverage was rather biased.

feedback.es: I would say y un adjetivo moderado como rather suavizan la crítica; las otras frases son absolutas.

hint.es: Suaviza con I would say y una palabra como rather.

prompt.es: Completa: «Tienes razón: esa crítica es válida.»

feedback.es: You have a point es la fórmula para conceder un argumento al otro.

hint.es: Se dice «tienes un …», no «tienes razón» literalmente.

origin.text: You have a ___: that criticism is valid.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Dicho esto, en conjunto la cobertura fue justa.»

feedback.es: That said vuelve al argumento contrario y on balance abre la conclusión.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada expresión con lo que hace en una valoración.

feedback.es: Cada expresión cumple una función: conceder, suavizar, concluir o volver a tu argumento.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta concede un punto y matiza la crítica?

choices.text: You have a point, but I would say it gave both sides to some extent.

feedback.es: Concede el punto con you have a point y matiza con I would say… to some extent; las otras respuestas rechazan o exageran.

prompt.es: Escribe tu valoración: opinión suavizada, evidencia, concesión y conclusión.

answer.text: I would say the coverage was fairly balanced because it gave both sides of the story. The council and the residents both explained their reasons. You have a point about the headline: it was rather loaded. That said, the report named its sources, so to some extent the criticism is not fair. On balance, the coverage was fair.
accepted: I would say the coverage was fairly balanced because it gave both sides of the story. The council and the residents both explained their reasons. You have a point about the headline: it was rather loaded. That said, the report named its sources, so to some extent the criticism is not fair. On balance, the coverage was fair.

In my opinion, the coverage was fairly balanced because it gave both sides. That said, to some extent the headline was loaded, and you have a point about it. The report named both sources. On balance, it was fair.

feedback.es: Una buena valoración abre con una opinión suave, da evidencia, concede un punto, matiza y termina con on balance.

origin.text: Caso: una noticia sobre el cierre de una piscina. Tiene dos fuentes (el ayuntamiento y los vecinos), pero el titular dice «Ayuntamiento deja sin piscina a los niños». Escribe 4 o 5 frases: tu valoración suavizada, la evidencia, una concesión, un matiz y una conclusión.
